_note: Level L->L+1 costs 'upgrade_cost' * (L), except Blacksmith which uses hardcoded Lv1→2 (ore+gold) and Lv2→3 (adds dark gold) in GameState.facility_upgrade_cost (DECISIONS #222). Max level is capped at the Scroll cap; raising the cap from C to C+1 costs cap_scrolls[C-1] Scrolls of Upgrade (hard cap 'max'). Sum of cap_scrolls over all facilities = total Scroll supply (DECISIONS #150).

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
blacksmith.desc: Forge & upgrade gear (+1 per level cap), repair cracked gear, melt spare rings. Lv2→Lv3 needs Dark Gold.

alchemy.name: Alchemy Pot
alchemy.desc: Brew potions. Lv2: Starter Elixirs. Potion belt = level+1.

guild.name: Guild Hall
guild.desc: Supplies & Offline Patrols (2h/4h/8h by level). Rations and torches per expedition: 3/6/10 by level.

enchanter.name: Enchanter's Desk
enchanter.desc: Identify curios over time (faster and one more at a time per level; a known type is instant); scribe Scrolls of Passage. Levels rings and wands (cap +0/+1/+3 by Desk level) and repairs rings, wands and artifacts from Lv2.
